description: A plausible mid-tenure Android user: a populated address book, months of SMS including bank alerts, camera-roll photos, and a call log. Targets the emptiness checks evasive banking trojans run before unpacking.
rationale: Anatsa and Xenomorph droppers query the contacts and SMS providers and stay dormant when they return zero rows - an empty address book is the cheapest sandbox tell there is.
SOVA and CraxsRAT samples look for existing bank-alert SMS to decide which institution to overlay, so the inbox has to name real senders.
A device with no photos and no call history is not a device anyone banks from.
